methodology: Static code inspection of HEAD baseline. Classifications are advisory for Phase 1+; no code was changed.

classification_legend.WRAP_WITH_HERMES: deterministic capability that a Hermes skill may invoke read-only, keep Python as executor
classification_legend.AI_ASSISTED: inherently AI work, keep but bound scope
classification_legend.REPLACE_ONLY_IF_PROVEN: candidate for replacement only after proven parity
classification_legend.DEPRECATE_LATER: superseded or stubbed, no active consumers

run_nexus_full_activation.name: Full activation orchestrator
run_nexus_full_activation.rationale: Deterministic subprocess orchestrator; staging-only writes. Core daily go-to path.

run_daily_operating_cycle.name: Daily operating cycle (08:00)
run_daily_operating_cycle.rationale: Runs the 25-command DAILY_COMMANDS from operating_cycle_common.py deterministically.

run_evening_closeout_cycle.name: Evening closeout cycle (18:00)
run_evening_closeout_cycle.rationale: Deterministic closeout; blocker matrix, checklist, revenue, review queue.

nexus_runner.name: Agent job runner
nexus_runner.rationale: Claims/updates agent_jobs with heartbeats; allowlisted handler dispatch. Deterministic execution engine.

run_social_publish_job.name: Social publish worker
run_social_publish_job.rationale: Facebook publisher, dry-run default, approval-gated. Keep until social publishing is proven safe; only then evaluate a Hermes-gated equivalent.

nexus_telegram_bridge.name: Telegram operator console
nexus_telegram_bridge.rationale: Mobile operator console, search-API only, no chat-completion. Protected production path until Gateway parity.

nova_telegram_worker.name: Nova Telegram worker
nova_telegram_worker.rationale: Isolated conversational agent; deterministic pre-model gate, redaction allowlist, read-only Supabase. Keep as Hermes-family agent.

alpha_telegram_worker.name: Alpha Telegram worker
alpha_telegram_worker.rationale: Alpha external-research ingestion; mission → intent → live research → synthesis. Keep isolated from client PII.

alpha_live_research.name: Alpha live research bridge
alpha_live_research.rationale: Brave + YouTube + OpenRouter synthesis, deterministic fallback. The primary external-research feed. Keep; harden evidence provenance.

nexus_oanda_practice_engine.name: OANDA practice trading engine
nexus_oanda_practice_engine.rationale: Practice-only; deterministic risk/strategy logic; restricted to api-fxpractice. Do not convert to AI.

model_router.name: Model/provider policy router
model_router.rationale: Deterministic sensitivity→route decision layer. Exemplar of deterministic-first routing; the anchor for all model-tier work.

governed_approvals.name: Governed approval engine
governed_approvals.rationale: Single-use, TTL, action-bound approvals. Security-critical; must not be replaced with an LLM.

governed_policy_gate.name: Policy gate
governed_policy_gate.rationale: 10 deterministic checks precede any execution. Hermes may consume it read-only via a read-only tool; never bypass.

governed_action_registry.name: Action registry
governed_action_registry.rationale: LOW-risk executable set + PROHIBITED list. Deterministic authority.

governed_work_orders.name: Work-order state machine
governed_work_orders.rationale: State machine with idempotency keys. Deterministic; do not move to LLM.

capability_dispatcher.name: Capability dispatcher (contracts)
capability_dispatcher.rationale: Signed capability dispatch with typed contracts. The correct integration point for a Hermes plugin.

capabilities_registry.name: Per-agent capability registry
capabilities_registry.rationale: Static capability catalogs; expose read-only to the plugin so Hermes can discover Nexus capabilities deterministically.

nexus_knowledge.name: Nexus knowledge registry
nexus_knowledge.rationale: Structural knowledge + live state readers. Read-only, no credentials.

nexus_query_planner.name: Nova semantic query planner
nexus_query_planner.rationale: Deterministic plan → validate → execute with schema gates. Pre-model gate is a model-tier pattern to reuse.

hermes_graph.name: Hermes LangGraph
hermes_graph.rationale: Conversational front brain + governed engine. Graph is the right abstraction for chat routing; keep behind flag with sync fallback.

alpha_graph.name: Alpha LangGraph
alpha_graph.rationale: Research decision graph; keep as the explicit research-reasoning surface.

nova_graph.name: Nova LangGraph
nova_graph.rationale: Isolated conversational graph with capability gate; keep isolated.

temporal_workflows.name: Temporal workflow layer
temporal_workflows.rationale: Durable scheduled reports/email/recovery. Keep; do not replace with Hermes delegation.

litellm_gateway.name: LiteLLM model gateway adapter
litellm_gateway.rationale: Model-call adapter. Keep as the LLM transport; route through model_router.

supabase_schema.name: Supabase schema + RLS
supabase_schema.rationale: Authoritative business truth; 114 RLS tables, 208 policies. Do not replace or weaken.

youtube_metadata_intake.name: YouTube API metadata intake
youtube_metadata_intake.rationale: Approved-metadata-only, quota-aware connector. Deterministic research feed.

youtube_transcript_import.name: YouTube transcript import
youtube_transcript_import.rationale: Approved local TXT ingestion; no media download. Keep deterministic.

research_source_scoring.name: Research source scout/scoring
research_source_scoring.rationale: Deterministic scoring under research_safety_policy; source registry is authority.

hermes_web_search.name: Hermes web-search harness
hermes_web_search.rationale: Provider-abstraction harness (brave/tavily/serpapi/searxng). Zero keys configured; needs env, not replacement.

alpha_research_boundary.name: Alpha PII isolation contract
alpha_research_boundary.rationale: Alpha must not receive client PII. Contract is code-enforced today (NOVA/Alpha allowlists). Preserve.

client_vault_contract.name: Client vault contract
client_vault_contract.rationale: Mock-only, not_connected_by_design. Do not flip live without separate approval.

client_portal_v2.name: Client Portal V2
client_portal_v2.rationale: PROTECTED complete layer. Do not redesign; only justified narrow integration.

command_center_v1.name: Command Center (V1 panels)
command_center_v1.rationale: Existing admin panels are the integration target for Mission Control V2. Extend, do not rebuild.

run_nexus_research_cycle.name: Research cycle stub (disabled plist)
run_nexus_research_cycle.rationale: Disabled plist; superseded by schedule registry research entries.

run_nexus_operational_cycle.name: Legacy 2-hour operational cycle
run_nexus_operational_cycle.rationale: Superseded by daily/evening cycles; keep available, avoid parallel expansion.

summary.note: No deterministic process is classified REPLACE. The vertical slice for Phase 1+ must AVOID touching any KEEP_PYTHON path.
